review_findings: The scheduler reuses the existing Host transport and Orchestrator instead of becoming a second session or TaskRun writer.
Provider authentication remains outside the generic scheduler; the scheduler owns only durable exact-wait delivery.
Per-session serialization covers different events racing for the same active wait, while deterministic event identity covers duplicate deliveries.
Reservation plus existing pending-transition reconciliation closes the process-crash window without blindly repeating a resume.
The one-shot CLI supports webhook-triggered wake and cron-triggered bounded drain without a daemon or polling provider state.
Product source, completion policy, Quality, Write Authority, Human Gate, release, production, and merge code are outside scope.

skill_rule_mappings.assessment: ChatGPT, Codex, webhooks, and cron call the same root scheduler CLI and existing Host transport
scheduler cannot write session/TaskRun state and calls only RESUME_EXTERNAL or RECONCILE
event, reservation, TaskRun checkpoint proof, and delivery receipt are exact and persistent
mismatch, tampering, stale revision, competing event, and ambiguous crash state cannot resume
all scheduler files remain under Harness control-plane paths and are not application dependencies
